profile.name_en: PI C-867 Dual-Axis Piezo Positioning Controller
profile.description: 该设备是用于双轴压电定位平台的运动控制器，可通过串口设置伺服、回参考、设定速度并执行X/Y精密移动与位置读取，常用于显微成像等实验中的样品精密扫描与对准。
profile.description_en: This device is a motion controller for a dual-axis piezo positioning stage. It communicates over serial commands to enable servo control, perform referencing, set velocity, execute precise X/Y motion, and read back position, commonly for sample scanning and alignment in microscopy and other precision lab experiments.

PI C-867 Dual-Axis Piezo Positioning Controller
该设备是用于双轴压电定位平台的运动控制器，可通过串口设置伺服、回参考、设定速度并执行X/Y精密移动与位置读取，常用于显微成像等实验中的样品精密扫描与对准。

This device is a motion controller for a dual-axis piezo positioning stage. It communicates over serial commands to enable servo control, perform referencing, set velocity, execute precise X/Y motion, and read back position, commonly for sample scanning and alignment in microscopy and other precision lab experiments.
